dedupe_keys.name: supermap reservoir digital twin five layers one platform reference architecture for flood control

description: This SuperMap article proposes a layered Five-Layers One-Platform architecture for a reservoir digital twin, aimed at medium-sized reservoirs, and describes what each layer does. The perception layer gathers satellite, drone and ground monitoring plus dam sensors such as piezometers and displacement meters; the network layer carries data over Modbus, OPC-UA and MQTT; the data and model platform layer holds a data backbone, model-as-a-service and a reservoir knowledge graph; the simulation layer combines 3D geometric, physical, rule and AI models; and the application layer supports flood control forecasting, warning, pre-running and plan generation, plus water scheduling. Coverage: a reference design, not a deployment with results. Access: an open article about a commercial product line; the price and licence are not stated. Caveats: vendor marketing, with no performance evidence. It supports design of dam and reservoir digital twins and emergency rehearsal, and relates to the Chongqing sponge city intelligent stormwater control case study in the catalogue.
